context: Merge gate for pull requests in hermes-discord-quota, a Python Hermes Agent plugin enforcing per-user Discord spending quotas. Each item summarises one PR after a review/fix round: the issue's acceptance criteria, the test result, the latest reviewer findings that were retained as actionable and impactful, the status of earlier retained comments, and the diff stat. A PR should merge only when it meets the acceptance criteria, tests pass, and no retained review comment is still open.

ready_to_merge.instructions: Is this pull request ready to merge into main?

criteria.true: Tests pass, every acceptance criterion is plausibly covered by the change and its tests, the latest review round retained no new findings, and all earlier retained comments are resolved.
criteria.false: Tests fail or were not run, an acceptance criterion looks uncovered, a retained comment is unresolved, or the latest review retained new findings.

examples.item: Tests: passed (24 passed). New retained findings: none. Earlier retained: R1-1 resolved, R1-2 resolved. Acceptance criteria: 4 listed, implementer reports all covered.
Tests: passed (12 passed). New retained findings: R2-1 [high] reliability: exception in hook escapes to gateway. Earlier retained: R1-1 resolved.
Tests: failed (2 failed, 10 passed). New retained findings: none. Earlier retained: none.
